properties.description: Databricks workspace running every notebook activity: 00_get_metadata, 01_ingest_hana_to_landing, 00_update_watermark, 01_landing_to_silver, 03_silver_to_gold and 04_aggregated_audit. Both pipelines reference this one. ls_azure_databricks is an earlier duplicate pointing at the same workspace and cluster, kept only so an existing deployment does not break; nothing references it. Authenticates with a Databricks personal access token, which ADF stores as an encryptedCredential and which therefore cannot be committed — supply it via accessToken in ADF Studio, or switch the linked service to MSI so no secret is needed at all.
